the amide inhibitors have improved water solubilities and decreased melting points, and the potency of amide compounds for murine sEH is similar to that for urea compounds, but 2.5-3 times weaker inhibition of human sEH is observed.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the amide function can be used in the design of sEH inhibitors with improved water solibility and reduced melting points.
the amide function can replace the urea function as the pharmacophore in sEH inhibitors without loss of inhibition potency and with a significant improvement in water solubility and melting point.
the urea function can be replaced with an amide function in the design of potent and selective sEH inhibitors without losing potency.
